{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Directly exposes manual pruning and flushing functions in src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.h and src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.cpp, with extensive test coverage in src/test/kernel/test_kernel.cpp.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Exposes manual pruning and chainstate flushing in libbitcoinkernel, resolving a key limitation where downstream applications cannot open datadirs from pruned nodes. The PR addresses #35627 and downstream demand (kernel-node#111) so external users can manage block storage bounds."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Does not touch mempool data structures, acceptance, or relay policy.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "This PR touches block storage and kernel APIs; it has no relation to mempool logic."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes to test files (src/test/kernel/test_kernel.cpp, src/test/chainstate_write_tests.cpp) test kernel and validation features rather than test framework infrastructure.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "The included tests verify specific kernel and block storage behavior and do not modify shared test framework machinery."
    },
    {
      "name": "tools",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes to src/bitcoin-chainstate.cpp are minimal adaptations of the kernel example code.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "src/bitcoin-chainstate.cpp is an example client maintained as part of the kernel project, not an operator or developer CLI tool covered by tools."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Edits to src/init.cpp are mechanical call-site adjustments following changes in validation and block storage.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The PR does not touch shared utilities, logging, threading, or serialization primitives."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Labeled Validation; substantively alters block file deletion, prune bookkeeping, and flush invariants in src/node/blockstorage.cpp and src/validation.cpp.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.40,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Decouples block storage pruning and deferred file deletion from ChainstateManager into BlockManager, fixing a leak of unlinked files across failed flushes and preserving recovery blocks during reorgs. Because this change substantively alters validation and block storage invariants alongside public kernel API additions, it touches two distinct areas and would benefit from splitting."
    }
  ],

  }
